study_identification_part.si_4_title: Investigating dopaminergic abnormalities in schizophrenia and /uniFB01 rst-episode psychosis with normative modelling and multisite molecular neuroimaging

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Multiple datasets without standard consortium names: two [11C]-(+)-PHNO datasets (PET/CT, PET/MR) and six [18F]FDOPA datasets (FDOPA_HC01, FDOPA_HC02, FDOPA_01-04) collected across multiple scanners/sites.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "we used two datasets [40, 41] of [ 11 C]-( + )-PHNO PET imaging data... acquired with two scanners"; "The datasets consisted of two datasets of HC only (FDOPA_HC01 and FDOPA_HC02), three case-control datasets (FDOPA_01, FDOPA_02, and FDOPA_03) and one dataset of patients only (FDOPA_04)."; "Data were acquired with five different scanners... in three different imaging sites"
